name: Ulric Vane
backstory: A stonemason's boy who survived the burning of Dunmarrow in 1463, Ulric has tended its graves ever since, living in the ruined chapel with a goat and saying the names aloud. He let the Order build its hall on three conditions and helped open the keep's sealed vault.
dm_only: He saw a coffin-shaped iron box go into the keep and believes the Order entombed one of its dead; he doesn't know about the Coal.

relationships.name: Chadickith
relationships.how: made the bargain for the hall with him
